title: Chicken and vegetable entree with noodles, diet frozen meal

content.title: About
content.content: Chicken and vegetable entree with noodles is a diet frozen meal designed for quick and convenient preparation. It contains pieces of chicken breast, a mix of carrots, broccoli, sweet pepper, and whole‑grain noodles. The meal is low in fat and calories while preserving flavor and nutrients.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The meal was formulated with dietitian input to reduce calories without sacrificing taste.
Chicken breast is flash‑frozen to retain tenderness and nutritional value.
Vegetables are cut into small pieces to ensure rapid heating in the microwave.
Whole‑grain noodles provide slower‑releasing carbohydrates compared with regular noodles.
No artificial colors or flavorings are added.

items.title: High in protein
items.content: Chicken breast supplies high‑quality protein essential for maintaining muscle mass.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: The meal contains minimal saturated fat, making it suitable for low‑fat diets.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals
items.content: The vegetable blend provides vitamins A, C, folate, and potassium, supporting overall health.

items.title: Fiber
items.content: Whole‑grain noodles and vegetables add dietary fiber, aiding digestion.

items.title: Low calorie
items.content: One serving provides roughly 250 kcal, convenient for weight management.

items.title: Chicken allergy
items.content: Individuals with a poultry allergy should avoid this product.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: The meal contains a moderate amount of salt; those limiting sodium should take this into account.

items.title: Requires thorough heating
items.content: Insufficient heating may leave harmful bacteria; follow the cooking instructions carefully.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Microwave the frozen meal on high for 3–4 minutes, stir, and let stand for 1 minute. Optionally garnish with fresh herbs or a splash of soy sauce.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the product frozen at –18 °C (0 °F) or lower. Once thawed, consume within 24 hours and do not store in the refrigerator for more than 2 days.
